trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 1 negation-contrast construction(s): ", not calibrated." — state the positive claim directly

Full read of the proof (baseline, Wedderburn 3-term, Delta_W / Delta_{T=1}, evaluation, Witness, Scope, structural extension). The Scope paragraph carries three denials — 'no continuous parameters are fitted', 'no choices were made by selecting from a menu of variants', 'is predictive, not calibrated' — but each is a distinct anti-fit disclosure the corpus requires (continuous-parameter fitting / model selection / calibration are three different objections), so this is the substantive-distinction false-positive class rather than assertion-by-denial.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: Density noted: four negation forms in one 60-word paragraph. If a later editor tightens it, the redundant member is 'not calibrated', already implied by the two preceding denials.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Linear: term-by-term justification, then evaluation, then scope, then the open extension. No setup-then-reframe.

trap-em-dash.evidence: Three spaced dashes: one true paired parenthetical ('across A = 1 to 7 — including the unfitted extension to 6Li and 7Li — is predictive') and one appended consequence ('several algebraically-natural variants — hence is technically fitted'). trap-superlative.evidence: Two unqualified maximum-strength claims. (1) 'The systematic binding under-prediction is the formula's principal limitation' — contradicted by the block's own sibling table (tbl:derived-mass-formula-light-isotopes-table2-data): the deuteron is OVER-predicted, B_pred +3.14 vs AME +2.22 (+41%). Under-prediction holds for 5 of 6 tabulated isotopes, not systematically. (2) 'The atomic mass agreement to sub-percent across A = 1 to 7 ... is **predictive**, not calibrated' — the quantity scored is dominated by the CODATA baseline Z*m_p + N*m_n + Z*m_e, which the same proof calls 'CODATA inputs'; recomputing from Table 1, the 4He 'sub-percent' error 0.576% IS the 21.5 MeV binding shortfall divided by 3728.40 MeV, so sub-percent-on-the-total is arithmetically equivalent to 'binding is under 1% of the mass' and carries no predictive content of its own.
trap-superlative.notes: Proposed (structural, not applied — both are factual corrections): (1) 'The binding under-prediction for A >= 3 (32% to 76%) is the formula's principal limitation; the deuteron is over-predicted by 41%.' (2) Scope the predictive claim to what is actually scoreable: the binding energies and the p-n splitting, not the absolute atomic mass in MeV — per the absolute-mass excision (AGENTS.md 2026-08-11) and the calibration-input correction (2026-08-18). As written the paragraph scores a calibration pass-through.
